Title: Generally available: Azure Redis Cache Premium tier in India and Canada

Body.Content:
The Azure Redis Cache Premium tier is enterprise ready. This tier can be used as a cache and to persist data for resiliency against potential data loss. It's designed for maximum scale and enterprise integration.

The Premium tier is now generally available in India and Canada; Basic and Standard tiers were already available. In these regions, the service is using regional meters for the Premium tier only.

For more information, please visit the Azure Redis Cache documentation page and the Azure Redis Cache pricing page.
